posts.title: Software in the age of coding agents
Using Codex to finish Algo
posts.description: Reflects on using Codex to finish the Algo Elixir package, covering where it helped, where it fell short, and why human review remained the bottleneck.

posts.title: Algo: a Ramda-like Elixir package for working with lists, nested maps and keyword lists
posts.description: Introduces Algo, an Elixir utility package for practical data transformations with nested maps, keyword lists, collection helpers, and naming choices that make immutable updates read more clearly.
